event_rule: For each original ACIB Full seed/sequence: unique first complete ownership divergence, first N10, first direct harmful own-KEEP override, first N01. Events are posthoc TRAIN diagnostics, not learned runtime selection.
prestate: Same original treatment state immediately before the selected frame, reproduced from sole click and sealed actual candidates. Never an independent C0 future state.
baseline_branch: Clone that treatment's prestate, disable actor and use original C0 association. Distinct from independent historical C0.
KEEP_branch: Same joint prestate and current identity actor; score proposals but execute KEEP and feed back actual committed UID.
alternative_rule: Choose highest raw anchor cosine or baseline target-column score among current real UIDs different from own KEEP; stable UID tie-break. No GT-best choice. Hard-infeasible alternatives explicitly fail without override.
forced_rule: Replay the originally sealed GT-free selected action at the event. A KEEP onset is a real no-intervention control, not an effective action.
followup: After the one tested action, all actor branches use KEEP for 100 original future frames; baseline branch retains no actor. This isolates a one-shot action's causal joint-state propagation, not a new online controller or oracle rollout.
branch_state_isolation: Independent trackers, managers, mutable identity banks, pending proposals and anchors; frozen inference parameters may be shared, forward scratch read immediately only.
